elements.content:
So many ways to travel.

We can go by car.

Driving, driving, driving in my car.

We can go by boat.

Rowing, rowing, rowing in my boat.

We can go by train.

Chuffing, chuffing, chuffing in my train.

We can go by plane.

Flying, flying, flying in my plane.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 去旅游
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
去旅游有好多方式。

我们可以乘小汽车。

开呀，开呀，开小汽车。

我们可以乘船去。

划呀，划呀，划船。

我们可以乘火车去。

咔嚓，咔嚓，坐火车。

我们可以乘飞机去。

飞呀，飞呀，坐飞机。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
